hypothesis: Point-in-time money-flow alignment and an untuned 1.0x relative-volume baseline may distinguish weak Hulk expansion entries without requiring a new hard gate or sacrificing bidirectional cadence.
decision: Keep the features annotation-only. A new report-only mechanism groups every reconciled Hulk lifecycle symmetrically as flow-and-volume, one-of-two, neither, or unavailable. The first two attributable closed live trades were both profitable BTC longs in the neither bucket, totaling +$0.343915; the current SOL neither-bucket long remains unresolved. This directly contradicts treating low volume and opposing flow as an automatic veto. Continue collecting resolved live outcomes before evaluating the predeclared scaling challenger; do not gate or resize the running strategy from this evidence.
falsifier: Update this decision if independent reconciled live outcomes show materially worse after-cost profit factor and drawdown for the neither bucket than supported buckets, and a prospectively frozen symmetric scaled or gated treatment preserves useful bidirectional cadence. Two historical winners or one current loss are not sufficient alone.
limitations: The two closed trades are insufficient to establish a durable entry-quality edge.
The open SOL lifecycle is excluded from realized statistics.
The 1.0x relative-volume threshold is an untuned baseline and not a proven economic cutoff.
Mixed live profile sizes make net USD descriptive rather than portfolio additive.
The mechanism does not route, gate, size, submit, close, or alter any order.
